_readme: Network tariff catalogue used by every version, generated by make_tariffs.py from the networks' published price lists (edit that script, not this file). Rates are for the financial year below. status 'placeholder' entries are NOT real tariffs, and fields named in toConfirm are unverified: see PLACEHOLDERS.md. Units: energy c/kWh (peak/shoulder/offPeak; a flat tariff has all three equal), demand $/kVA/month on average monthly peak demand, fixed $/day. Eligibility: annual MWh bounds (null = no bound) and connection voltage (LV or HV); the app suggests the first tariff of a network that fits a site and warns when the chosen one doesn't. history (index reference tariffs only) holds past financial years' rates, used by the bulk price index for dates in those years. demand.lines are the demand charges as a bill shows them (rate is their sum); energyWindows names the network's own peak/shoulder/offPeak windows (null for a flat tariff). periods describes the network's time windows; notes lists how the published tariff was simplified for the model.

tariffs.name: Small business time-of-use
tariffs.periods: Peak 3pm-9pm working weekdays, Nov-Mar and Jun-Aug (no peak in Apr, May, Sep, Oct); off-peak all other times. No shoulder period.
notes: Small business sites up to 100 MWh a year (the 2026-27 threshold for moving to EA302).
tariffs.source: Ausgrid Network Price List 2026-27 (updated 27 Apr 2026), p1, prices excl. GST

tariffs.name: LV business 100-160 MWh
tariffs.periods: Peak 3pm-9pm working weekdays, Nov-Mar and Jun-Aug (no peak in Apr, May, Sep, Oct); off-peak all other times. No shoulder period. Demand: highest 30-minute demand in the peak window.
notes: Demand charge is 48.3397 c/kW/day, used here as per kVA and applied every month.
tariffs.source: Ausgrid Network Price List 2026-27 (updated 27 Apr 2026), p1, prices excl. GST

tariffs.name: LV business 160-750 MWh
tariffs.periods: Peak 3pm-9pm working weekdays, Nov-Mar and Jun-Aug (no peak in Apr, May, Sep, Oct); off-peak all other times. No shoulder period.
notes: Capacity charge 57.7962 c/kVA/day on the site's peak-window demand.
tariffs.source: Ausgrid Network Price List 2026-27 (updated 27 Apr 2026), p1, prices excl. GST

tariffs.name: LV business over 750 MWh
tariffs.periods: Peak 3pm-9pm working weekdays, Nov-Mar and Jun-Aug (no peak in Apr, May, Sep, Oct); off-peak all other times. No shoulder period.
notes: Capacity charge 59.5298 c/kVA/day on the site's peak-window demand.
tariffs.source: Ausgrid Network Price List 2026-27 (updated 27 Apr 2026), p1, prices excl. GST

tariffs.name: HV connection
tariffs.periods: Peak 3pm-9pm working weekdays, Nov-Mar and Jun-Aug (no peak in Apr, May, Sep, Oct); off-peak all other times. No shoulder period.
notes: Capacity charge 34.6232 c/kVA/day on the site's peak-window demand.
tariffs.source: Ausgrid Network Price List 2026-27 (updated 27 Apr 2026), p1, prices excl. GST

tariffs.name: General supply seasonal time-of-use
tariffs.periods: Peak 4pm-8pm business days; solar soak 10am-2pm every day (charged as the shoulder rate here); off-peak all other times. Peak rate averages high season (Nov-Mar) and low season (Apr-Oct).
notes: Default for low-voltage business sites, including all new sites until 12 months of use show over 160 MWh.
tariffs.source: Endeavour Energy Network Price List: Network Tariffs 2026-27, Table 1a (NUOS, excl. GST), sections 6.1 and 9

tariffs.name: LV seasonal time-of-use demand
tariffs.periods: Peak 4pm-8pm business days; off-peak all other times (no shoulder). Peak energy and demand average high season (Nov-Mar) and low season (Apr-Oct); demand is charged in the peak window only.
notes: Default for LV business sites over 160 MWh a year with kVA demand metering.
tariffs.source: Endeavour Energy Network Price List: Network Tariffs 2026-27, Table 1a (NUOS, excl. GST), sections 6.1 and 9

tariffs.name: HV seasonal time-of-use demand
tariffs.periods: Peak 4pm-8pm business days; off-peak all other times (no shoulder). Peak energy and demand average high season (Nov-Mar) and low season (Apr-Oct); demand is charged in the peak window only.
tariffs.source: Endeavour Energy Network Price List: Network Tariffs 2026-27, Table 1a (NUOS, excl. GST), sections 6.1 and 9

tariffs.name: Small business time-of-use (Sun Soaker)
tariffs.periods: Peak 7am-10am and 3pm-10pm every day; off-peak 10am-3pm and 10pm-7am. No shoulder period.
notes: Default for new and upgraded small business sites up to 160 MWh a year.
tariffs.source: Essential Energy Network Price List and Explanatory Notes 2026-27 (V2), pp1-2 and section 5

tariffs.name: LV large business demand
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 7am-5pm and 8pm-10pm weekdays; off-peak 10pm-7am weekdays and all weekend. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA in each period, each month.
notes: Default for LV business sites over 160 MWh a year.
Three demand charges, each on its own monthly maximum: peak (12.0390), shoulder (10.8924) and off-peak (2.8541) $/kVA/month.
tariffs.source: Essential Energy Network Price List and Explanatory Notes 2026-27 (V2), pp1-2 and section 5

tariffs.name: LV demand, alternative
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 7am-5pm and 8pm-10pm weekdays; off-peak 10pm-7am weekdays and all weekend. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA in the peak or shoulder period, each month.
notes: Optional instead of BLND3AO: higher energy rates, one lower demand charge.
tariffs.source: Essential Energy Network Price List and Explanatory Notes 2026-27 (V2), pp1-2 and section 5

tariffs.name: HV business demand
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 7am-5pm and 8pm-10pm weekdays; off-peak 10pm-7am weekdays and all weekend. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA in each period, each month.
notes: Default for business sites connected and metered at HV.
Three demand charges, each on its own monthly maximum: peak (11.5026), shoulder (10.4071) and off-peak (3.1143) $/kVA/month.
tariffs.source: Essential Energy Network Price List and Explanatory Notes 2026-27 (V2), pp1-2 and section 5

tariffs.name: Small business time-of-use (closed to new sites)
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 7am-5pm and 8pm-10pm weekdays; off-peak 10pm-7am weekdays and all weekend.
notes: Obsolete: existing sites only, not available for new connections or tariff changes.
tariffs.source: Essential Energy Network Price List and Explanatory Notes 2026-27 (V2), pp1-2 and section 5

tariffs.name: Small business time-of-use energy
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 1pm-5pm and 8pm-11am weekdays, 1pm-11am weekends; off-peak 11am-1pm every day.
notes: Default for small business sites (up to 100 MWh a year) with a smart meter.
tariffs.source: Energex 2026-27 Network Price List (updated for Sch 8), NUOS and Metering tables; Energex Network Tariff Guide 2026-27

lines.label: Shoulder demand
lines.window: all times except 11am-1pm and the peak window

tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 1pm-5pm and 8pm-11am weekdays, 1pm-11am weekends; off-peak 11am-1pm every day. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA in the peak and shoulder windows, each month.
notes: Default for sites over 100 MWh a year with a smart meter.
Two demand charges, each on its own monthly maximum: peak (13.913) and shoulder (3.672) $/kVA/month.

tariffs.name: Demand small (anytime demand)
tariffs.periods: Flat energy rate at all times. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA at any time, each month.
notes: Optional for sites over 100 MWh a year with kVA metering.
tariffs.source: Energex 2026-27 Network Price List (updated for Sch 8), NUOS and Metering tables; Energex Network Tariff Guide 2026-27

tariffs.name: Large time-of-use energy
tariffs.periods: Peak 5pm-8pm weekdays; shoulder 1pm-5pm and 8pm-11am weekdays, 1pm-11am weekends; off-peak 11am-1pm every day.
notes: Optional for sites using 100-160 MWh a year with monthly peak demand over 120 kVA.

tariffs.name: 11kV time-of-use demand (line connected)
tariffs.periods: Flat energy rate at all times. Demand: highest 30-minute kVA 9am-9pm weekdays, each month.
notes: Default for sites connected to an 11 kV line.
Connection unit charges ($7.525/unit/day) are site-specific and not included.
tariffs.source: Energex 2026-27 Network Price List (updated for Sch 8), NUOS and Metering tables; Energex Network Tariff Guide 2026-27

tariffs.name: 11kV bus (dedicated feeder)
tariffs.periods: Peak 7am-11pm weekdays, off-peak other times (same energy rate). Demand: highest 30-minute kVA, each month.
notes: Default for sites on a dedicated 11 kV feeder from a zone substation bus.
Connection unit charges ($7.525/unit/day) are site-specific and not included.
tariffs.source: Energex 2026-27 Network Price List (updated for Sch 8), NUOS and Metering tables; Energex Network Tariff Guide 2026-27
